permit-exception: Every report-request duty, including a separately extracted workshop example, retains missing-required-report applicability and the valid-exemption exception. Grouped complete statements are allowed.
Retain at least ten working days to respond to that request. Do not apply the request deadline or duty to exempt applicants.
format-recommendation: Readable-copy and separately extracted spreadsheet example remain recommendations (kind recommendation), conditional on receiving an obsolete-format file and practicable conversion.
Original-file retention remains a requirement in the obsolete-file situation, whether or not conversion is practicable. Do not add practicable conversion as a retention precondition.
descriptive-possibility: Retain address verification before resending when a notice is returned undeliverable.
Temporary relocation during home repairs remains descriptive possibility, kind statement or background; no permission to move and no new duty to relocate, investigate repairs, or prove relocation.
Retain that an address mismatch alone does not prove false information. Do not strengthen this into a ban on considering mismatches or a new investigation requirement.

scoring: Review all raw meanings against every case criterion, counting omissions, lost conditions/exceptions, unsupported additions and modal errors separately. A separate condition or evidence quote does not repair an incomplete standalone duty. Record segmentation choices without requiring a fixed unit count.
decision: All revised cells must satisfy all criteria without a new substantive error to pass the transfer gate. If both arms pass, report no new measured gain on these cases; assess this as a regression check alongside the separate teacher result. A treatment failure blocks a general robustness claim regardless of improvements elsewhere.
limits: These are newly authored synthetic fixtures, fixed before calls. They were not used to develop or revise the tested instruction. They are not an independently curated benchmark or representative real-document evaluation.
budget: Exactly 12 calls: three cases x two arms x two repeats. Gemini gemini-3.8-flash, medium thinking, temperature zero, no numeric thinking budget or application output cap. No retries, repairs, full audits, or instruction changes.
